source_tweet.text:
We're heading to Tokyo Game Show 2026! ✨

Drop by to be one of the first to experience Stellar Blade on Nintendo Switch 2! 

And don't miss a special live stage appearance from Kim Hyung Tae himself on Sunday, Sept 20! (Don’t worry if you can’t make it, it will also be streamed live on YouTube!)

We can't wait to see you there! 💙
